node.title: KoalaBear m2 u2 universal component-color profile cut
node.closure: four-edge component color class cuts five universal K-fiber profiles to three
node.statement: For every residual degree-two source component, the four J incidences outside the common K fibers are exactly the left colored degrees of its four-edge color class in the two-regular pole graph. Hence every outside-K deficit is at most two and the universal K-fiber degree profile is exactly one of (2,2,4,4,4,4), (2,3,3,4,4,4), or (3,3,3,3,4,4). The first two prior five-profile cases are impossible and every J label occurs over K. No surviving profile or stabilizer type is deleted.
